scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run check:css && vite build && npm run check:public
scripts.db:migrate: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler d1 migrations apply lionfeather-site --remote
scripts.deploy:check: npm run build && npm run check:resume && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run check:resume && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.format: prettier --write src worker scripts build index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json README.md AGENTS.md .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src worker scripts build index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json README.md AGENTS.md .prettierrc.json
scripts.service:prepare: npm run build && node scripts/service.mjs prepare
scripts.service:install: npm run build && node scripts/service.mjs install --boot --verify
